from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches

prs = Presentation("deck.pptx")
slide = prs.slides[2]
shapes = list(slide.shapes)
# The copy is the lowest shape that carries text and spans most of the width;
# the diagram is everything that starts below it.
text_shapes = [s for s in shapes if s.has_text_frame and s.text_frame.text.strip()
               and s.width > prs.slide_width * 0.5]
copy = max(text_shapes, key=lambda s: s.top)
copy_bottom = copy.top + copy.height
below = [s for s in shapes if s.top >= copy_bottom]
if below:
    gap = min(s.top for s in below) - copy_bottom
    shift = gap - Inches(0.4)
    if shift > 0:
        for s in below:
            s.top = s.top - shift
prs.save("deck.pptx")

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.oxml.ns import qn
from pptx.oxml import parse_xml

prs = Presentation("deck.pptx")
W, H = prs.slide_width, prs.slide_height
A = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main"

def luminance(rgb):
    return 0.2126 * rgb[0] + 0.7152 * rgb[1] + 0.0722 * rgb[2]

for slide in prs.slides:
    # The page's ground is a full-bleed shape at the back; the mark sits just
    # in front of it, so every piece of copy stays on top of the mark.
    grounds = [s for s in slide.shapes
               if s.left <= 0 and s.top <= 0 and s.width >= W and s.height >= H]
    ground_rgb = (255, 255, 255)
    if grounds:
        try:
            ground_rgb = tuple(grounds[-1].fill.fore_color.rgb)
        except Exception:
            pass
    ink = (RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF) if luminance(ground_rgb) < 128
           else RGBColor(0x1D, 0x27, 0x33))

    box_w, box_h = Inches(9.0), Inches(2.4)
    box = slide.shapes.add_textbox(int((W - box_w) / 2), int((H - box_h) / 2),
                                   box_w, box_h)
    box.name = "ts-background-draft-watermark"
    box.rotation = -30
    tf = box.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = False
    run = tf.paragraphs[0].add_run()
    run.text = "DRAFT"
    run.font.size = Pt(150)
    run.font.bold = True
    run.font.color.rgb = ink
    # 12% opaque, so the copy in front of it stays legible.
    srgb = run._r.find(qn("a:rPr")).find(qn("a:solidFill")).find(qn("a:srgbClr"))
    srgb.append(parse_xml('<a:alpha xmlns:a="%s" val="12000"/>' % A))

    tree = slide.shapes._spTree
    tree.remove(box._element)
    index = 2
    if grounds:
        index = list(tree).index(grounds[-1]._element) + 1
    tree.insert(index, box._element)

prs.save("deck.pptx")
arguments.intent: set a large, faint, diagonal DRAFT mark centred on every page, behind the copy
